evaluation: fixed SMART 3-fold held-week blocks; earlier validation is known development

representation.PSD: Welch, detrend constant, 1-second segments for SMART; published averaged PSD for RWTH
representation.triaxial: mean of per-axis dimensionless signatures; conditional alignment, not guaranteed scalar equivalence

bridge.diagnostics: leave-one-session-out within RWTH training, compare operating-regime-only control
bridge.extrapolation_policy: exclude projected TRI training cases outside the RWTH training predictor min/max box; report all coverage; not a guarantee of conditional support

classifiers.weighting: equal total class mass within each source; TRI source total mass specified, source-domain indicators excluded

tri_policy.labels: original measured-fault reference, never inferred from bridge output
tri_policy.feature_origin: estimated from public paired RWTH relation, not measured vibration

probability: uncalibrated reference-state score; selected-cohort class prevalence is not deployment prevalence
normality_auxiliary: normal-only IsolationForest scores can be compared as exploratory descriptors, never substituted for Random Forest objective
